Read an rxode2 or nlmixr2 model function

Source: R/read-rxode2.R
pmx_read_rxode2.Rd

Reads the ini({}) and model({}) blocks of a model function into the package's representation. The function is read as R syntax, so neither rxode2 nor nlmixr2 needs to be installed.

Usage

pmx_read_rxode2(model)

Arguments

model

A model function, as written for rxode2 or nlmixr2.

Value

A zufapmx_model; see pmx_inspect and pmx_write_rxode2().

Details

Supported: fixed effects with bounds and fix(); random effects, alone or in blocks; statements built from the function table; linCmt(); d/dt(); alag(), lag(), f(), rate(), dur() and initial amounts (depot(0) <-); time as t or time; and residual models add(), prop(), add() + prop(), lnorm() and pow() whose parameters are ini() parameters or model() variables. Anything else is refused with an error of class zufapmx_parse_error.

Recorded as losses of the read: label()s, description and other top-level metadata such as reference or units, and ini() values written as constant expressions (log(90)), which are evaluated. Comments are not part of a function's code and never reach the reader. Statements that read time belong to the ODE structure, since rxode2's time is continuous; a linCmt() model refuses them.

See also

Other readers: pmx_read_mrgsolve(), pmx_read_nonmem()

Examples

one_cmt <- function() {
  ini({
    tka <- 0.45
    tcl <- 1
    tv <- 3.45
    eta.cl ~ 0.3
    prop.sd <- 0.1
  })
  model({
    ka <- exp(tka)
    cl <- exp(tcl + eta.cl)
    v <- exp(tv)
    cp <- linCmt()
    cp ~ prop(prop.sd)
  })
}
pmx_read_rxode2(one_cmt)
#> <zufapmx_model> read from rxode2
#> Structure: one-compartment closed form, first-order input (ADVAN2 TRANS2)
#> Parameters: 4, initial values only
#> Random effects: eta.cl on cl (exp)
#> Endpoints: cp (proportional)
